chunks: A Bedouin came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: “O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, I used to have a strong memory, and I have become forgetful.”
He said: “Did you used to take a midday nap?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “And you left that?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “Resume it.”
So he resumed it, and his mental sharpness returned to him.

key_terms.أَعْرَابِيٌّ: a Bedouin, a desert Arab who came to ask the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.تَقِيلُ: you would take a midday nap (qailulah)
key_terms.ذَاكَ: that practice, referring to the midday nap
key_terms.ذَكُورًا: possessing strong memory or good recollection
key_terms.ذِهْنُهُ: his mental sharpness, mind, or power of recollection
key_terms.نَسِيًّا: forgetful; one who has become prone to forgetting

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم recommend for forgetfulness and weak memory?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that a Bedouin complained to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم about becoming forgetful after previously having strong memory. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم connected this change to leaving the practice of the midday nap and instructed him to resume it, after which his mental sharpness returned.
